decisions.title: await reference implementation = background + notification
decisions.summary: Foreground Bash is hard-capped at 600,000ms and background task-notifications re-wake the root agent (both observed 2026-09-02): waves >10min use `wave start` + end turn + wait for notification; `await --timeout` capped at 540s.
